name: Chrome Hearts Black & Multicolor Star Patch Leather Pants
basis_of_authenticity: Dealer listing: sold as authentic by Savonches. No outside legit check; the basis is the dealer only.
model: Custom order (dealer): black cow leather, multicolour leather star patches. Condition: new (dealer).
size: Dealer lists 44; the size tag reads "Custom Size"
what_the_tags_read: Leather label: embossed scroll, CHROME HEARTS in gothic letters; under it a gothic "USA" between two small cross marks. Stitched all round.
Leather tab under the label: embossed "DJ KHALED" in plain capitals (a name in place of a size).
Size tag: CHROME HEARTS scroll, "RN # 97729" at the fold, second scroll, "Custom Size".
Composition tag: "BODY: LEATHER: COW / LINING: 100% COTTON / LEATHER 2: CALF / LEATHER 3: LAMB"; "CORPS: CUIR: VACHE / DOUBLURE: 100% COTON / CUIR 2: VEAU / CUIR 3: AGNEAU"; "MADE IN U.S.A.".

White printed care tag: five care symbols, "PROFESSIONAL LEATHER DRY CLEAN ONLY", "NETTOYAGE À SEC PROFESSIONNEL DU CUIR UNIQUEMENT", then Japanese, Korean and Chinese lines; CHROME HEARTS scroll sideways on the facing tag.
Lining: black fabric with tone-on-tone Chrome Hearts emblems.
